data.content:
Machine Learning
Machine Learning is a subset of artificial intelligence that enables computers to learn from data without being explicitly programmed.

Artificial Intelligence
Artificial Intelligence is the broader field that encompasses Machine Learning.

Recommendation Systems
Recommendation Systems utilize Machine Learning to suggest products or services based on user behavior and preferences.

Speech Recognition
Speech Recognition is an application of Machine Learning that enables computers to recognize and transcribe spoken language.

Fraud Detection
Fraud Detection is an application of Machine Learning that identifies and prevents fraudulent activities.

Self-Driving Cars
Self-Driving Cars utilize Machine Learning to navigate and make decisions in real-time.

Supervised Learning
Supervised Learning is a type of Machine Learning where the model learns from labeled data.

Unsupervised Learning
Unsupervised Learning is a type of Machine Learning where the model identifies patterns in unlabeled data.

Reinforcement Learning
Reinforcement Learning is a type of Machine Learning where the model learns by interacting with an environment.

Dataset
A Dataset is a collection of data used to train and test models.

Features
Features are individual measurable properties of data.

Model
A Model is a mathematical representation learned from data.

Training
Training is the process of teaching a model using data.

Testing
Testing is the process of evaluating a model's performance on unseen data.

Linear Regression
Linear Regression is a common algorithm used in Machine Learning.

Decision Trees
Decision Trees are a common algorithm used in Machine Learning.

Support Vector Machines
Support Vector Machines are a common algorithm used in Machine Learning.

Neural Networks
Neural Networks are a common algorithm used in Machine Learning.

Overfitting
Overfitting occurs when a model learns too much detail from training data.

Underfitting
Underfitting occurs when a model is too simple to capture patterns.

Healthcare
Healthcare is an industry that utilizes Machine Learning for disease prediction and medical imaging.

Finance
Finance is an industry that utilizes Machine Learning for fraud detection and risk assessment.

E-commerce
E-commerce is an industry that utilizes Machine Learning for product recommendations and customer segmentation.

Transportation
Transportation is an industry that utilizes Machine Learning for autonomous vehicles and traffic prediction.

Deep Learning
Deep Learning is a subfield of Machine Learning that involves the use of neural networks.

Natural Language Processing
Natural Language Processing is a subfield of Machine Learning that involves the use of algorithms to process and understand human language.

Generative AI
Generative AI is a subfield of Machine Learning that involves the use of algorithms to generate new data.

Environment
Reinforcement Learning learns by interacting with an Environment.
